map.利息保障倍数低于多少算危险？: How low must the interest coverage ratio be to count as dangerous?
map.一般认为低于 1.5 倍风险明显上升，低于 1 倍则经营利润已不足以付息；但周期: It is generally held that below 1.5 times the risk rises markedly, and below 1 time operating profit is no longer enough to pay interest; but cyclical industries fluctuate greatly, so the long-run average should be used.
map.分子用 EBIT 还是 EBITDA？: Use EBIT or EBITDA in the numerator?
map.用 EBIT 更保守（已含折旧摊销的付现压力）；部分行业用 EBITDA 覆盖（: EBIT is more conservative (it already includes the cash pressure of depreciation and amortization); some industries use EBITDA coverage (since depreciation is non-cash), but that overstates the ability to pay interest.
